title: Grasse jasminum grandiflorum: Behind the scenes of an iconic harvest
summary: In early October, dsm-firmenich invited a select group of journalists and content creators to the Grasse region, the birthplace of Grandiflorum jasmine (Jasminum grandiflorum), commonly known as Grasse jasmine. The immersive experience offered a glimpse into the heart of the harvest of what locals simply call “the flower,” such is its deep-rooted place in the region's heritage. It was also an opportunity to (re)discover the many facets of this iconic raw material, an essential ingredient in... - Ingredients & formulation
